subuddha.p: [ su + buddha= budha + ta. Kaccaññaḥ. 557. ] (pu) Google Translate (1) Good-True God. (2) Subodhu Brahmin.

R:
subuddha：သု-ဗုဒ္ဓ （တိ）
ချမ်းသာစွာ နိုးသည်။
DOP: buddha mfn., m., and n. [ ts; pp of bujjhati 1 qv ], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) understood; known; Abh 757 (~aṃ ñātaṃ); S I 120, 14* (satipaññā ca me ~ā; Spk I 182, 22 foll.: mayā mayhaṃ sati ca paññā ca ñātā); Vism 209, 17 (yaṃ pana kiñci atthi ñeyyaṃ nāma sabbass’ eva °-ttā … ~o); It-a II 186, 13 (yo yo attho yathā yathā bujjhitabbo tathā tathā ~o ñāto attapaccakkho kato ti); Bv-a 25, 28 (devamanussehi sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā ti evaṃ °-ttā ñātattā ~o idha kammakārake buddhasaddasiddhi daṭṭhabbā); Sadd 482, 4 (adhigataguṇavisesehi khīṇāsavehi bujjhitabbo ti ~o); — ( ii ) who has great understanding, wise; Abh 229 (medhāvī … ~o ca dabbaviddasu); 1043 (~o tu paṇḍite); Ja IV 187, 7 (titthiyā … kiṃ samaṇo Gotamo ~o mayaṃ pi ~ā … amhākaṃ pi detha karothā ti); Mil 21, 27 (~ānaṃ viññūnaṃ … sandassento navaṅgaṃ jinasāsanaratanaṃ); — esp. who has understood the true nature of the world of experience; who has understood saṃsāra and the way to release from it; Sn 643 (cutiṃ yo vedi sattānaṃ upapattiṃ ca sabbaso asattaṃ sugataṃ ~aṃ tam ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ; Pj II 470, 7 : catunnaṃ saccānaṃ °-tāya ~aṃ); Th 1207 (Māra nibbinda ~amhā āsaṃ mākāsi bhikkhusu; or ‘the Buddha’; Th-a III 179, 34 : catusaccabuddhato buddhasāvakato nibbinda); Mp I 115, 16 (cattāro hi ~ā sutabuddho catusaccabuddho paccekabuddho sabbaññubuddho ti … bahussuto bhikkhu sutabuddho nāma khīṇāsavo catusaccabuddho nāma); Dhp-a III 237, 22 foll. (~ā ca paccekabuddhā ca anubuddhā cā ti ime hi tayo ~ā); — ( iii ) who has realised, understood by himself, the true nature of the world of experience; D III 54, 27 (~o so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti) = M I 235, 30 (Ps II 282, 4 : bhagavā sayaṃ pi cattāri saccāni ~o); Sn 993 (~o so bhagavā loke dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā); Vism 202, 5 (sabbadhamme sammā sāmaṃ ca ~o); Sv 40, 29 (sayaṃ nikkileso nikkilesehi sayaṃ ~o anubuddhehi parivārito); Ud-a 133, 19 (… parinibbuto parinibbāpessāmi ~o bodhessāmī ti); Ap-a 100, 34 (pāṭi-ekkaṃ visuṃ ~ā ti paccekabuddhā); Bv-a 90, 30 (~o bodhetā tiṇṇo tāretā mutto mocetā bhaveyyan ti); — ( iv ) awakened, awake; open, blooming; Pj II 210, 14 (aññāṇasayanato paṭibuddhattā ~aṃ); 426, 20 (~o nāma buddhisampanno kilesaniddāvibuddho ca); It-a II 43, 18 (vyañjanato pana savāsanāya kilesaniddāya accantavigamena buddhavā paṭibuddhavā ti ~o, buddhiyā vā vikasitabhāvena buddhavā vibuddhavā ti ~o, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); Sadd 483, 28 (~o pabuddho); — 2. ( m. , sometimes pl., of respect ), ( i ) one who has realised, understood by himself the true nature of the world of experience; one who has understood saṃsāra and the way to release from it; an omniscient being, a buddha; Abh 1; 1043 (~o … jine); Vin II 190, 20 (ahaṃ bhagavantaṃ hantvā ~o bhavissāmī ti); III 7, 23 (katamesānaṃ kho ~ānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi); V 117, 15 (dve puggalā abhabbā āpattiṃ āpajjituṃ ~ā ca paccekabuddhā ca); D III 146, 27 (~o samāno kiṃ labhati); M I 380, 2 (yā ~ānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ); II 143, 30* (abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ ca bhāvitaṃ pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me tasmā ~o ’smi brāhmaṇa); 144, 22* (pāragū sabbadhammānaṃ ~o tādi pavuccati); S I 140, 11* (ye ca atītā sambuddhā ye ca ~ā anāgatā yo c’ etarahi sambuddho); 210, 32 (assosi kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ~o kira loke uppanno ti); Dhp 182 (kiccho ~ānaṃ uppādo); 387 (atha sabbam ahorattiṃ ~o tapati tejasā); Sn 517 (pattaṃ jātikkhayaṃ tam āhu ~aṃ); Th 491 (vītataṇhā anādānā satta ~ā khayogadhā); Ja I 12, 8 (~o ti kho ghosamattaṃ pi loke dullabhaṃ pageva buddhuppādo); 14, 9* (sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā ~o hessaṃ); 49, 21 (~ā nāma vessakule vā suddakule vā na nibbattanti); 51, 3 (sace agārā nikkhamma pabbajissati ~o bhavissati loke vivattacchaddo ti); IV 271, 22 (nāhaṃ sabbaññū ~o); Ap 33, 15 (~asmiṃ lokanāthasmiṃ); 414, 16 (Kosiko nāma bhagavā … jhāyī jhānarato ~o); 429, 21 (yadā Dīpaṅkaro ~o Sumedhaṃ vyākarī jino); Paṭis I 174, 3 foll. (~o ti yo so bhagavā sayambhū anācariyako pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ patto balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ; Paṭis-a 485, 5 foll. ); Ap 299, 8 (~-tte pi vipaccati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °’-atthe, prob. wr ); Kv 281, 2 foll. (bodhiyā ~o ti); 608, 12 (atthi ~ānaṃ ~ehi hīnātirekatā ti); Mil 237, 16 (yadi dutiyo ~o uppajjeyya nāyaṃ dasasahassī lokadhātu dhāreyya); 285, 9 (sabbe pi ~ā °-dhammehi samasamā ti); Sv 248, 18 (imasmiṃ loke ahaṃ ~o ahaṃ ~o ti uggatassa nāmaṃ gahetvā bahujanā vicaranti); 410, 30 (Koṇḍañño nāma ~o eko va ekasmiṃ kappe uppanno); Spk II 40, 17 (~esu uppannesu anuppannesu pi jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ); 390, 20 (anāgate Metteyyo nāma ~o bhavissati); Mp I 201, 15 (paṇītapaṇītaṃ ~ānaṃ patte patiṭṭhāpesi; Mp-ṭ [ Be ] I 158, 5 : ~ānan ti gāravavasena bahuvacananiddeso kato); Pj II 335, 22 (eko pi hi ~o samathavipassanādhammaṃ adesetvā parinibbuto nāma natthi); 391, 19 (na dāni °-ttaṃ apāpuṇitvā pallaṅkaṃ bhindissāmī ti); — ( ii ) a paccekabuddha ( qv sv pacceka ); A I 77, 18 (tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho paccekabuddho ca, ime kho bhikkhave dve ~ā ti); Ja III 408, 18* (na kir’ atthi … pāricariyā ~esu appikā; 409, 1´ : ~esū ti paccekabuddhesu); 411, 10* (caturo samaṇe addasaṃ … sītibhūte anāsave … adaṃ ~ānaṃ kummāsaṃ); Paṭis II 140, 13 (etena maggena ~ā ca sāvakā ca agataṃ disaṃ nibbānaṃ gacchantī ti; Paṭis-a 608, 17 : paccekabuddhā pi saṅgahitā); Ap 6, 13 (samāgatā bahū ~ā arahanto ca sabbaso; Ap-a 114, 4 : anekasatasahassasaṅkhyā paccekabuddhā, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); 178, 15 (tamhi pabbatapādamhi satta ~ā vasanti te; Ap-a 449, 16 : satta paccekabuddhā); — ( iii ) esp. the Buddha of the present world-age, Gotama; Vin III 1, 6 (tena samayena ~o bhagavā Verañjāyaṃ viharati); 1, 16 (iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho … satthā devamanussānaṃ ~o bhagavā); 24, 31 (asakyaputtiyabhāvaṃ patthayamāno yannūnāhaṃ ~aṃ paccakkheyyan ti vadati); 177, 18 (amhākaṃ ~o amhākaṃ dhammo amhākaṃ ayyaputtena dhammo abhisamito); 189, 11 (upāsikā nāma ~aṃ saraṇaṃ gatā dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā); D II 123, 9* (anubuddhā ime dhammā Gotamena yasassinā iti ~o abhiññāya dhammam akkhāsi bhikkhunaṃ); III 197, 26* (vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ ~aṃ vandāma Gotamaṃ); M II 100, 9* (~o ca kho kāruṇiko mahesi yo satthā lokassa sadevakassa taṃ ehi bhikkhū ti tadā avoca); S I 25, 1* (tathāgatassa ~assa sabbabhūtānukampino); 42, 18* (~o pavadataṃ varo); 132, 31* (~o dhammam adesesi jātiyā samatikkamaṃ); III 86, 1* (yadā ~o abhiññāya dhammacakkaṃ pavattayi); Sn 408 (agamā Rājagahaṃ ~o); 1133 (tamonudo ~o samantacakkhu); Pv 21:61 (tāvatiṃse yadā ~o sīlāyaṃ paṇḍukambale … vihāsi); Th 24 (tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ ~assa sāsanaṃ); Nidd I 341, 10 (bhagavā suriyassa gottañātako gottabandhu tasmā ~o ādiccabandhū ti); Mil 28, 10 (yadi ~o tiṭṭheyya sādhukāraṃ dadeyya); 70, 5 foll. (bhante Nāgasena ~o tayā diṭṭho ti); 73, 9 (bhante Nāgasena ~o atthī ti); 76, 10 (atthi pana bhante ~assa upasampadā udāhu natthī ti); 95, 10 foll. (yadi ~o pūjaṃ sādiyati na parinibbuto ~o); 278, 24 (ten’ eva atidānena Vessantaro rājā ajj’ etarahi ~o jāto); Ud-a 276, 14 (sace pana ~ānaṃ mātā Mahāmāyādevī dhareyya); Th-a III 135, 14 (laddhaṃ dāni mayā ~ānaṃ paribhogacīvaraṃ); Sadd 73, 32* (sabbaññū sugato ~o dhammarājā tathāgato); — buddho in Ee at Ap 494, 14 is wr; Be, Se duṭṭho; Ce ruṭṭho; — buddho in Ee at Vism 136, 3* is wr for budho ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — buddhe in Ee at Paṭis I 174, 4 is wr for pubbe ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — buddhena in Ee at Bv-a 2, 19* is wr for budhena ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — 3. ( n. ) knowledge, understanding; Pj I 16, 2 (buddhi ~aṃ bodho ti pariyāyavacanaṃ etaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bodhī ti) = Nidd-a I 442, 33 = Paṭis-a 486, 20 ≠ Ap-a 100, 13 (… bodho ti anatthantaraṃ etaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce atthantaraṃ etaṃ; Ee bodhe ti atthantaraṃ etaṃ); Bv-a 25, 29 (~aṃ assa atthī ti vā buddho, buddhavanto ti attho); Sadd 482, 6 (bujjhatī ti buddhi, evaṃ ~aṃ bodho bodhi ca); 877, 22 (to napuṃsake: … gamanaṃ gataṃ … bujjhanaṃ ~aṃ); — °- aṃsumāli(n) , m. , Buddha (like) the sun; Sās 1, 3* ; — °’- aṅkura , m. , one destined to become a buddha; Ja I 16, 19 (Sumedhatāpaso kira °-bījaṃ ~o ti) = Ap-a 18, 30 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-bījaṅkuro ~o cā ti); Ja IV 328, 4 (~o esa, imasmiṃ yeva kappe sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇissati); Dhp-a I 83, 22 ; — ° ânujā , f. , a younger sister of the Buddha; Ap 574, 1 ; — ° ânubuddha , mfn. , who gains full understanding from a buddha; Vin III 8, 10 (tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena ~ānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena); S I 194, 18* (~o so thero Kondañño; Spk I 282, 29 : satthā paṭhamaṃ cattāri saccāni bujjhi pacchā thero tasmā ~o ti vuccati) = Th 1246 ≠ 679 (Th-a III 5, 14 : ~o ti buddhānaṃ anubuddho, sammāsambuddhehi bujjhitāni saccāni tesaṃ desanānusārena bujjhatī ti attho); Ud-a 324, 4 (~esu aggasāvakamahāsāvakesu); — ° ânussati , f. , calling the Buddha to mind; D III 250, 11 (cha anussatiṭṭhānāni, ~i dhammānussati …); A I 30, 8 (ekadhammo … bhāvito … nibbānāya saṃvattati … ~i); Ap 69, 18 (bhāvehi ~iṃ); Vism 197, 8 (buddhaṃ ārabbha uppannā anussati ~i, buddhaguṇārammaṇāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Dhp-a III 455, 15 (~iṃ āvajjitvā namo buddhassā ti vatvā guḷaṃ khipati); Th-a II 165, 2 ; — °’- antara , n. , the period between buddha s, when no buddha is alive in the world; Mil 3, 20 (te ubho pi devesu ca manussesu ca saṃsarantā ekaṃ ~aṃ khepesuṃ); Sp 512, 6 (ekaṃ ~aṃ niraye paccitvā); Mp I 279, 18 (so ekaṃ ~aṃ devaloke vasitvā imasmiṃ buddhuppāde … kulagehe nibbatto); II 192, 12 (~e … paccekabuddhānaṃ santike ovādaṃ labhitvā); Dhp-a I 103, 4 (imasmiṃ kappe cattāri ~āni petaloke yeva nibbattiṃsu); 103, 22 (tesaṃ ekaṃ ~aṃ svedivasasadisaṃ ahosi); Pv-a 21, 21 (tato ekasmiṃ ~e vītivatte loke amhākaṃ bhagavā uppajji); — ° âpadāniya , mfn. , concerning the Buddha’ s previous actions; Ap 6, 18 (bhagavā attano buddhacariyaṃ sambhāvayamāno ~aṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ abhāsitthā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee buddhānaṃ ’padāniyaṃ; Ap-a 127, 29 : buddhakāraṇapakāsakaṃ nāma, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee buddhakāraṇāpakāsanaṃ) ≠ Cp p. 37, 2 (Cp-a 335, 17 : buddhānaṃ purātanakammaṃ porāṇaṃ dukkarakiriyaṃ adhikicca pavattattā desitattā ~an ti evaṃnāmakaṃ); — °’- ālaya , m. , an impersonation of the Buddha, a false Buddha; Mil 203, 21 (Devadatto … iddhiṃ nibbattetvā ~aṃ akāsi); — see also sugatālaya ( sv sugata ); — °’- āsane in Ee at Ja II 268, 25 is wr for °-sāsane ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- kolāhala , n. , an uproar about (the appearance of) a buddha; Ja I 47, 21 (Tusitapure vasante yeva pana bodhisatte ~aṃ nāma udapādi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-halāhalaṃ) = Ap-a 52, 6 ; Ps V 91, 18 (mahantaṃ ~aṃ ahosi); Pj I 121, 13 (suddhāvāsā pana devā … vassasahassassa accayena buddho loke uppajjissatī ti manussapathe vicaritvā ārocenti idaṃ ~aṃ nāma); — °- garahi(n) , mfn. , blaming, finding fault with, the Buddha; Vin III 23, 9 (na mayaṃ … ~ino … attagarahino mayaṃ; Sp 229, 11 foll.: buddhaṃ na garahamā na buddhassa dosaṃ vadema); — °- cakkhu , n. , a buddha’ s vision, power of seeing; Vin I 6, 25 (addasa kho bhagavā ~unā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe …; Sp 963, 3 : indriyaparopariyattiñāṇena ca āsayānusayañāṇena ca, imesaṃ hi dvinnaṃ ñāṇānaṃ ~ū ti nāmaṃ); Nidd I 45, 28 (maṃsacakkhunā pi passāmi … ~unā pi passāmi …); Paṭis II 33, 7 (yaṃ ~u taṃ °-ñāṇaṃ); Sp 71, 11 (bhagavā kir’ assa bodhimūle yeva ~unā lokaṃ oloketvā anāgate imassa dīpassa sampattiṃ disvā); Bv-a 12, 16 (~ussa āpāthaṃ āgacchantā); — °- cariyā , f. , the conduct of a buddha; Ap 6, 17 (attano ~aṃ sambhāvayamāno, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-caritaṃ; Ap-a 127, 27 : ~aṃ °-kāraṇaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee add : dhammaṃ); — buddhacariyā is an occasional wr (or vl) for buddhicariyā qv sv buddhi ; — °- paṭisaṃyutta , mfn. , connected with the Buddha; Vin IV 6, 18 (ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ ~aṃ); — °- (p)pamukha , mfn. , with the Buddha at the head; Vin IV 76, 16 (~o bhikkhusaṅgho); D II 88, 21 ; M III 255, 29 (~e ubhatosaṅghe dānaṃ deti); Ud 16, 31 ; Pv 30:8; Ja I 116, 31 (~āni pañcabhikkhusatāni); — °- māmaka , mfn. , devoted to the Buddha; Ja I 299, 15 (~o dhammamāmako saṅghamāmako); Nidd I 125, 3 ; Ap 469, 27 ; Dhp-a I 206, 5 ; — °- yuttaka , mfn. , fit for a buddha; Ap 96, 7 ; — °- raṃsyābhiphuṭṭha , mfn. , irradiated by the buddha’ s rays; Ap 193, 7 ( Ce ~o ’mhi; Be, Se °-raṃsīhi phuṭṭho; Ee wr °-raṃsābhighuṭṭho); — °- līḷhā , °-līḷā, °-līlā, f. , the grace, elegance, of a buddha; Ja I 93, 9 (bhagavā … anantāya ~āya appaṭisamāya °-siriyā Jetavanavihāraṃ pāvisi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-līḷāya); 491, 1 (Devadatto … ~aṃ karissāmī ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-līlaṃ); III 289, 2 (mahāsatto … madhurena sarena ~āya dhammaṃ desento, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-līḷāya); V 333, 17 (satthā … mahatiyā ~āya vicari, Ee so; Be, Ce °-līlāya; Se °-līḷāya); Dhp-a I 33, 18 (ajja °-visayaṃ ~aṃ passissāmā ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-līḷaṃ); Vv-a 217, 20 (~āya dhammaṃ desetuṃ ārabhi, Ce so; Be, Se °-līlāya; Ee °-līḷāya); Bv-a 276, 25 (tassa anantarūpaṃ °-līlhaṃ passituṃ labhissāmā ti, Ce, Ee so; Be °-līḷaṃ; Se °-līlaṃ); Mhbv 39, 6 ; — °- vaṃsa , m. , 1. the line, lineage, of buddha s; Ja I 1, 14* (~assa etassa icchantena ciraṭṭhitiṃ); 90, 5 (ayaṃ mahārāja rājavaṃso nāma tava vaṃso amhākaṃ pana Dīpaṅkaro … Kassapo ti ayaṃ ~o nāma) ≠ Sp 1007, 27 ; Cp-a 285, 18 (~aṃ °-tantiṃ °-paveṇiṃ °-dhammataṃ paripālessāmī ti); — 2. one of the collections making up the Khuddakanikāya of the Pāḷi Canon; Ja I 2, 29 ; Bv p. 102, 30 (~o niṭṭhito); Pj I 12, 9 (… apadānaṃ ~o cariyāpiṭakaṃ); Bv-a 2, 25 (pañcavīsatiyā buddhānaṃ uppannakappādiparicchedavasena paveṇivitthārakathā ~o nāmā ti); Cp-a 6, 13 (bhagavā … ~aṃ desesi); — ~’-aṭṭhakathā, f. , the commentary on the Buddhavaṃsa; Bv-a 299, 31 (madhuratthavilāsinī nāma ~’-atthakathā); — °- vacana , n. , the words, the teaching of the Buddha, esp. as collected in the Pāḷi Canon; Vin II 139, 7 foll. (te sakāya niruttiyā ~aṃ dūsenti, handa mayaṃ bhante ~aṃ chandaso āropemā ti); IV 54, 25 (taṃ yeva udānaṃ bhaṇati aññaṃ ca bahuṃ ~aṃ); Sn 202 (sutvāna ~aṃ); Th 403 (karotha ~aṃ; Th-a II 171, 38 foll.: buddhassa bhagavato vacanaṃ karotha yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipattiyā sampādetha); Ja IV 37, 7 (tepiṭakaṃ ~aṃ uggaṇhi); Mil 9, 27 (thokaṃ thokaṃ ~aṃ kathetvā); 17, 17 (jānāsi kho tvaṃ tāta ~aṃ nāmā ti, jānāmi kho ’haṃ gahapati abhidhammapadānī ti); Vism 442, 17 (pariyatti nāma ~assa pariyāpuṇanaṃ); Sv 15, 30 foll.; Spk II 203, 6 (yāva pana tepiṭakaṃ ~aṃ vattati na tāva sāsanaṃ antarahitan ti vattuṃ vattati); Paṭis-a 6, 12 (sammāsambuddho pi tepiṭakaṃ ~aṃ tantiṃ āropento Māgadhikabhāsāya eva āropesi); Ap-a 103, 1 (sakalaṃ ~aṃ ekavimuttirasan ti); Vibh-a 504, 5 (tepiṭakaṃ ~aṃ caturāsītidhammakkhandhasahassānī ti vadanti); Sadd 906, 26 (pāḷinayo ti tepiṭake ~e pāḷigati); — abuddhavacana, n. , not the words of the Buddha; Sp 742, 31 (-guḷhavessantaraguḷhavinayavedallapiṭakāni pana abuddhavacanāni yevā ti); Spk II 202, 1 ; — °- sāsana , n. , 1. the instruction, teaching, of the Buddha; Vin IV 218, 32 (satthusāsanenā ti jinasāsanena ~ena); S I 157, 19* (yuñjatha ~e) = Th 256; Dhp 368 (bhikkhu pasanno ~e); Thī 13 (karotha ~aṃ yaṃ katvā nānutappati; Thī-a 19, 25 : ovāda-anusiṭṭhiṃ karotha); 150 (tisso vijjā anuppattā amoghaṃ ~aṃ); Vism 605, 5 (~e laddhassāso); Th-a I 193, 24 (ito bahiddhā ti imasmā ~ā bāhirakasamaye); — abuddhasāsana, n. , what is not the teaching of the Buddha; Sp 874, 11 (mahāsaṅghikādayo ca abuddhasāsanaṃ buddhasāsanan ti vatvā); — 2. the dispensation of the Buddha, the Buddhist order or system; Ja I 85, 9 (tasmiṃ ārāmapaṭiggahaṇe ~assa mūlāni otiṇṇānī ti); 349, 1 (mahāseṭṭhi asītikoṭidhanaṃ ~e yeva vikiri); II 268, 25 (asuko bhikkhu niyyānike ~e pabbajitvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr buddhāsane); Mil 292, 11 (imasmiṃ ~e); Pj I 96, 28 (vinayo nāma ~assa āyu, vinaye ṭhite sāsanaṃ ṭhitaṃ hoti); — °- halāhala , n. , an uproar about (the appearance of) a buddha; Ja I 47, 21 (~aṃ nāma udapādi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-kolāhalaṃ = Ap-a 52, 6 : eds °-kolāhalaṃ); — abuddha , m. and mfn. , who has not true understanding; not a buddha; Ja I 276, 34 (te pana attano ~-bhāvena maṃ bujjhāpetuṃ nāsakkhiṃsu); Kv 281, 4 (bodhiyā buddho ti … bodhiyā niruddhāya … paṭipassaddhāya ~o hotī ti); Sv 824, 26 (ahaṃ ~o va samāno buddho ’mhī ti vicariṃ); 864, 11 (so hi … asinā sīse chijjamāne pi buddho ~o ti vā dhammo adhammo ti vā … na vadati); — subuddha , mfn. , 1. with excellent understanding; Sv 818, 29 (buddho pana ~o va dhammo svākkhāto va); Th-a II 78, 6 (sādhu ~assa sammāsambuddhassa sāsane, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sādhubuddhassa; ad Th 212: sādhu subuddhasāsane); — 2. well understood; ? Dhātuk 50, 9* ( in uddāna: esa nayo ~o); — see also āveṇikabuddhadhamma ( sv āveṇika ), dubbudha, sammāsambuddha.
